descriptive_conditions.selection: greedy at most 3; each addition retains >=100 events and >=6 years, improves pooled 20D fill by >=2%, and has positive median calendar-year uplift
descriptive_conditions.selector_order: positive-lift years, median annual lift, pooled lift, support, deterministic name
descriptive_conditions.thresholds: full-discovery q30/q50/q70 in the frozen economic direction; no arbitrary threshold search

corridor_density.definition: turnover mass per unit width in z=[-0.5,1.5), divided by local-reference mass per unit width

outcome_blind_low_inventory_mother.history: exactly 120 completed same-lineage hard-valid sessions, each with exactly 241 one-minute bars, before gap formation

inside_density.definition: turnover mass per unit width in z=[0,1), divided by local-reference mass per unit width

outcome_blind_low_inventory_mother.minute_price: amount/volume when volume>0, otherwise zero-weight typical price
outcome_blind_low_inventory_mother.minute_weight: PIT daily float-turnover multiplied by minute share of daily volume

pristine_first_return.departure: first 5 completed post-gap stock sessions all have High < L
pristine_first_return.first_return: earliest later completed 1-minute bar whose high reaches L from below
pristine_first_return.pre_departure_touch_policy: reject the gap permanently; never reset a later interaction as first return

source_population.construction: directly from governed PIT daily rows; no V6/V8 candidate input
source_population.formation_gate: completed current and previous rows are hard-valid, adjacent, corporate-action-safe, and in the same QD-010 lineage

stage_b_structural_outcome.primary: structural U full-fill within 20 completed stock sessions after pristine first return
